newsitem.title: USA: Wall Street stocks set new highs.
newsitem.headline: Wall Street stocks set new highs.

text.p: Stock market records were shattered Friday as fresh economic data pointed to moderating economic growth and tame inflation, heightening investor hopes that the Federal Reserve will leave interest rates unchanged.

Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow Jones industrial average ended up 66.58 points or 1.15 percent, at a record 5,838.52, beating the old high of 5,778.00 set on May 22. The Standard & Poor's composite index also set a new high.
In the broader market, advancing issues swamped declines 17-7 on active volume of 489 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
